_meta.method: WebSearch (standard; two extended) + WebFetch. No SerpAPI or paid tools. Carta pages returned HTTP 403 on every fetch, so all Carta figures are search-snippet only.

tier_legend.1: Primary data publisher / analyst / VC firm report (Tracxn, Inc42 data desk, Bain, Carta, Meritech, SaaS Capital, Bessemer, YC)
tier_legend.2: Reputable press reporting primary data (PTI, Storyboard18, MediaBrief, Business Standard)

verified_how_legend.fetched_page: Primary page fetched and figure/wording read on the page
verified_how_legend.fetched_secondary: Figure read on a fetched secondary page that cites the primary source; primary not opened
verified_how_legend.search_snippet: Seen only in search-result summaries; page not opened or fetch blocked
verified_how_legend.derived: Arithmetic by this agent from verified inputs; not stated by any source

_meta.verdict_pre_money: WITHIN the indicative Indian seed ranges (upper half), ABOVE the median implied by Indian round-size data, and FAR BELOW US seed medians. No tier-1 source publishes an India seed pre-money median; see items FR-21 to FR-24.

findings.finding: Inc42: seed-stage median ticket size flat at about $1M in H1 2025.
findings.quote: the median ticket size for seed stage startups remained largely flat at $1 Mn.
findings.source_title: Indian Startup Funding Jumps 8% YoY To $5.7 Bn In H1 2025

findings.finding: Median seed round in India Jan 1 - Aug 13, 2026 was INR 8.0 Cr (~US$0.8M), interquartile range INR 2.4-19.0 Cr; median Series A INR 50.8 Cr (~US$5.3M); median Series B INR 123.8 Cr (~US$13.0M). Based on a Tracxn export of 890 deals; post-money disclosed for only 39% of deals so valuation chart is directional (valuation medians in image, not readable).
findings.figure: Seed median INR 8.0 Cr (IQR 2.4-19.0 Cr); Series A median INR 50.8 Cr
findings.source_title: India Startup Funding Report 2026: 890 Deals Analyzed
findings.publisher: FinVal Research & Consultancy (data: Tracxn export pulled 2026-08-13)
findings.verified_how: fetched_page (tier-3 analysis of tier-1 Tracxn data; underlying export not seen)

findings.finding: Per Tracxn's India Tech H1 2026 report (as reported by StartupFeed): seed round count fell from 797 to 420 YoY; average seed cheque rose from $0.8M to $1.3M (INR 7.6 Cr to 12.3 Cr); total seed funding $541M; average early-stage cheque $8.5M to $14.9M.
findings.quote: Total seed funding still fell to $541 Mn (Rs 5,118 Cr), proving bigger cheques did not offset fewer deals.
findings.source_title: Seed Funding 2026: Bigger Cheques, Bolder Bets in India
findings.publisher: StartupFeed (citing Tracxn India Tech H1 2026 report)
findings.verified_how: fetched_secondary (Tracxn H1 2026 report itself not opened)

findings.finding: Tracxn 9M 2026 (Jan 1 - Sep 21, 2026): seed funding fell 37% to $698M; early-stage rose 27% to $4.2B; late-stage ~$5.4B; 1,134 rounds, down 38% from 1,838; Enterprise Applications grew 49% to $3.5B.
findings.quote: Seed funding fell 37% to $698M, while early-stage funding rose 27% to $4.2B and late-stage held roughly steady at $5.4B.
findings.source_title: India tech funding rises 7% to $10.3B as deal volume falls 38%: Tracxn

findings.finding: Tracxn full-year 2025: Indian tech funding $10.5B (-17%); seed-stage funding $1.1B, down 30% from 2024; early-stage $3.9B (+7%).
findings.quote: Seed-stage funding dropped to $1.1 billion, down 30% from 2024 and 25% from 2023,
findings.source_title: Tech startup funding falls 17% to $10.5 billion in 2025: Report

findings.finding: Tracxn 9M 2025: seed funding $727M (-39% YoY); median round size (all stages) nearly doubled to $1.5M from $683K.
findings.quote: The median round size nearly doubled to $1.5 million from $683,000 in the same period last year.
findings.source_title: India overtakes Germany, France to become world's 3rd-largest tech startup hub: Tracxn

findings.finding: PTI year-end wire: median deal size nearly doubled to about $1.4M in 2025 from roughly $700K in 2024 (article does not attribute the median to a named data source).
findings.quote: nearly doubled to about USD 1.4 million in 2025, from roughly USD 700,000 in 2024
findings.source_title: From funding winter to liquidity surge, 2025 marks turning point for Indian startups
findings.verified_how: fetched_page (source of median not named in article)

findings.finding: Inc42 2025 annual: early-stage (seed) startups raised $793M across 433 deals (-12% YoY); overall median ticket across stages up 11% to $3M; AI was the top seed-stage sector with $161M; enterprise tech raised $1.8B (82 deals).
findings.figure: Seed $793M / 433 deals; all-stage median US$3M (2025, Inc42 basis)
findings.quote: early stage startups raising $793 Mn, down 12% YoY, across 433 deals in 2025.
findings.source_title: Indian Startup Funding Declines 8% YoY To $11 Bn In 2025
findings.verified_how: fetched_page (note: Inc42 and Tracxn medians differ by methodology)

findings.finding: Bain India Venture Capital Report 2026: India VC/growth equity ~ $16B in 2025; software/SaaS funding rose ~1.5x YoY; small and mid-stage activity 'held firm'. No seed deal-size or valuation breakdown on the public page.
findings.source_title: India Venture Capital Report 2026

findings.finding: Carta, US startups, primary priced rounds: median seed round sold 19.5% (2025); less than 10% of 2025 software seed rounds sold 30%+.
findings.quote: the median seed round is 19.5% sold in this round
findings.source_title: Less Than 10 Percent of Seed Rounds Sell 30 Percent or More

findings.finding: Carta, US software rounds since 2021 (ex-bridges): after years at 20%, median dilution drifted to 19% at seed and 18% at Series A in 2025.
findings.quote: after many years with 20% dilution as the median at seed and Series A, that median has drifted down to 19% and 18% respectively so far in 2025
findings.source_title: Startup Dilution Per Round Is Not Rising Despite VC Claims

findings.finding: Carta, US software seed rounds closed in the six months to ~July 2026 (~1,000 rounds, no bridges): median valuation $24.3M on $4.1M raised; median dilution fell to 18%. Same post: Series A median $14.4M raised at $80M post-money. Pre-money ~ $20.2M is derived, assuming $24.3M is post-money (WaveUp describes it as post-money).
findings.figure: US software seed: $4.1M raised, $24.3M post, 18% dilution; Series A $14.4M at $80M post
findings.source_title: Top Seed Valuations Hit Record Highs in Q2 2026 / Carta LinkedIn data post
findings.verified_how: search_snippet (Carta fetch blocked; figure also appears on waveup.com/blog/seed-round-benchmarks, tier 3, not fetched)

findings.finding: Y Combinator (Sam Altman): aim to sell about 20% in the seed round; 25% acceptable for a 'large' seed (> $2.5M); raise enough to reach the next significant milestone (no month count given).
findings.quote: You should aim to sell only about 20% of the company in your seed round
findings.source_title: Fundraising Advice for YC Companies

findings.finding: Meritech Software Pulse 28-Aug-2026 (published 2026-09-01): overall median EV / implied ARR = 4.7x (47% below pre-ZIRP 8.7x); top-10 median 19.1x. This CONFIRMS the source document's 'median ~4.7x implied ARR in August 2026' claim, provided it cites the 28-Aug edition (the 14-Aug edition shows 4.3x).
findings.quote: the current overall median multiple of 4.7x is 47% below the pre-ZIRP median of 8.7x
findings.source_title: Meritech Software Pulse | 28-August-2026

findings.finding: Meritech Software Pulse 09-Oct-2026 (published 2026-10-13): overall median EV / implied ARR = 4.4x (50% below pre-ZIRP 8.7x); top-10 median 21.7x. Implied ARR = quarterly total revenue x 4. Intermediate editions: 14-Aug 4.3x; 11-Sep 4.2x; 25-Sep 4.0x.
findings.quote: While the current overall median multiple of 4.4x is 50% below the pre-ZIRP median of 8.7x,
findings.source_title: Meritech Software Pulse | 09-October-2026
findings.verified_how: fetched_page (14-Aug 4.3x also fetched; 11-Sep 4.2x and 25-Sep 4.0x read via saasvaluationmultiple.com, tier 3)

findings.finding: Meritech 14-Aug-2026: only 14 public software companies trade above 10x NTM revenue and 63% trade below 5x; high-growth Rule-of-40 leaders trade at ~12.0x / 14.7x vs ~4.5x / 4.8x for lower-growth, higher-FCF peers.
findings.quote: Only 14 public software companies trade above 10x NTM revenue, and 63% trade below 5x.
findings.source_title: Meritech Software Pulse | 14-August-2026

findings.finding: SaaS Capital (Jan 2025): SCI median 7.0x run-rate revenue at start of 2025; predicted private SaaS multiple 4.8x (bootstrapped) and 5.3x (equity-backed).
findings.quote: Data for equity-backed companies yields a predicted valuation multiple of 5.3x
findings.source_title: 2025 Private SaaS Company Valuations
findings.confidence: HIGH (for Jan 2025); likely overstated for 2026 given SCI decline

findings.finding: SaaS Capital (Apr 2026): SaaS valuations hit decade-plus lows in Q1 2026 as markets priced AI as an existential threat; the SCI ARR multiple sits at decade-plus lows. Current numeric SCI value (as of 2026-09-30) is in an image on the index page and could not be read.
findings.figure: SCI at decade-plus low (numeric value NOT VERIFIED)
findings.quote: SaaS valuations hit decade-plus lows in Q1 2026 as markets priced in AI as an existential threat.
findings.source_title: Four early 2026 SaaS trends

findings.finding: BVP Nasdaq Emerging Cloud Index site shows 'Average Revenue Multiple' 8.9x, total market cap $2.8T, average revenue growth 20.6%. No as-of date, median or forward/trailing basis shown. Average is skewed upward by top names; prefer Meritech median.
findings.source_title: BVP Nasdaq Emerging Cloud Index

findings.finding: Bessemer 'Scaling to $100 Million' (2021): at $1-10M ARR - growth avg ~200%, median 165%, top 230%+; NRR avg 140%, median 125%, top 145%+; gross margin avg 70%, median 72%, top 85%+; CAC payback avg ~15 months; targets <12 months SMB, <18 mid-market, <24 enterprise; invest in acquisition at CLTV/CAC >= 3x; efficiency score (FCF margin + growth) target ~70% at $25-50M ARR, ~50% at $100M+.
findings.figure: CAC payback <12 mo (SMB target); NRR median 125% at $1-10M ARR; GM median 72%
findings.source_title: Scaling to $100 Million

findings.finding: Bessemer State of AI 2025: AI 'Shooting Stars' reach ~$3M ARR in year 1, ~$12M year 2, ~$40M year 3, ~$103M year 4, with ~60% gross margins and ~$164K ARR/FTE; 'Supernovas' ~$40M ARR year 1 and ~$125M year 2 at ~25% gross margin, $1.13M ARR/FTE.
findings.source_title: The State of AI 2025

findings.finding: Carta x SVB data (US B2B SaaS, 2024): median ARR at Series A ~ $3M; 75th percentile nearly $7M. SVB H1 2025 reportedly put median Series A company revenue at ~ $2.5M.
findings.figure: Median ARR at Series A ~US$3M; top quartile ~US$7M (US, 2024)
findings.quote: median ARR at Series A was about $3M while the 75th percentile hit nearly $7M
findings.source_title: 7M ARR Gets You in the Top Quarter for Series A in 2025
findings.verified_how: search_snippet (Carta fetch blocked; SVB report page redirected to First Citizens and did not contain this figure)

findings.finding: Median Indian Series A round INR 50.8 Cr (~US$5.3M), Jan-Aug 2026 (see FR-02). Inc42 'growth stage' (its Series A-B bucket) median ticket $8M in H1 2025 and Q3 2025.
findings.source_title: India Startup Funding Report 2026: 890 Deals Analyzed

findings.finding: Treelife (advisory): indicative 2026 Indian pre-money ranges INR 25-70 Cr at seed (round INR 3-12 Cr) and INR 150-400 Cr at Series A (round INR 40-120 Cr). Article states these are 'indicative ranges, not statutory benchmarks' and cites no dataset for them.
findings.quote: These are indicative ranges, not statutory benchmarks.
findings.source_title: How Startup Valuation works in India: Methods, Metrics, Strategies

findings.finding: Implied India seed median post-money if the Tracxn-based median round (INR 8 Cr) is sold at ~20% dilution: ~INR 40 Cr post / ~INR 32 Cr pre. Aroh's INR 48 Cr pre is ~1.5x that implied median, inside Treelife's INR 25-70 Cr band, and ~25% of the US software seed median ($20.2M pre / $24.3M post). A INR 12 Cr raise is above the INR 8 Cr median but inside the INR 2.4-19 Cr interquartile range, and close to the H1 2026 Tracxn average seed cheque (INR 12.3 Cr).
findings.figure: Implied India median pre ~INR 32 Cr; Aroh INR 48 Cr
findings.source_title: Derived from FR-02, FR-03, FR-10/11/13, FR-12, FR-24
findings.confidence: LOW-MEDIUM (dilution for India assumed equal to US/YC norm)
